data.name: RiskNotice
data.value: Before proceeding, make sure you know how to use Windows PE and edit or repair EFI boot configurations.

data.value: I understand the risks and know how to recover the system.

data.name: DownloadNotice
data.value: Pinned to v2.1.5 · SHA-256 verified after download · Proxy applies to all downloads

data.name: InstallNotice
data.value: Add a GPU Unlock boot entry and keep Windows Boot Manager. Boot priority is preserved.

data.name: PriorityNotice
data.value: Move GPU Unlock to the top of the UEFI boot order, keeping Windows Boot Manager as a fallback and preserving other entries. The current order is backed up first; restart to verify actual boot behavior.

data.name: PriorityConsent
data.value: I understand that this changes the firmware boot order to run GPU Unlock first. If boot fails, I will select Windows Boot Manager in the BIOS boot menu to recover.

data.name: SetPriority
data.value: Set GPU Unlock as first boot entry

data.name: PriorityTooltip
data.value: Install to ESP or verify an existing installation, then accept this step's risk notice. No change is needed if GPU Unlock is already first and the fallback order is valid.

data.name: DiagnosticNotice
data.value: ssdiag requires administrator privileges and downloaded dependencies. It temporarily loads a kernel driver and may wake the GPU. It runs only when requested, without --reapply, and checks driver cleanup afterward.

data.name: DiagnosticTooltip
data.value: Download dependencies and run as administrator first.

data.name: GemmNotice
data.value: Uses cuBLAS directly, without Python or CUDA Toolkit. The first run downloads about 538 MiB of NVIDIA libraries using the current proxy. FP32 / TF32 / FP16 / BF16 are tested separately, with 2 seconds of warmup and about 1 second per round; the median is reported. FP16/BF16 use same-precision output and FP32 accumulation, with reduced-precision reduction disabled. Results do not determine unlock status. 20-series GPUs test FP32/FP16 only.

data.name: BaselineNotice
data.value: Detect unlock status before benchmarking. A locked run saves the baseline; after restarting and confirming the GPU is unlocked, test with the same round count to see the baseline and gain. Different GPUs, drivers, or test configurations are not compared.
